In return, I persuaded him to play for the Nottingham probation officers’ football team against the young monks based at Kelham Hall, near Newark.

notizie.titolo: Former DUP leader Jeffrey Donaldson sentenced to 15 years for child sexual offences
notizie.riassunto: Donaldson was found guilty in June of 18 counts of sexual abuse including one rape between 1985 and 2008 Jeffrey Donaldson has been sentenced to 15 years for sexual offences against two women who were children when he abused them, completing what was described as a “catastrophic descent into disgrace”.

notizie.titolo: Sally Rooney’s stand on Palestine is brave and humane
notizie.riassunto: The Normal People author’s determination to support Palestine Action, even if it means that her books are withdrawn from sale in the UK, makes a mockery of Britain’s terrorism laws It’s hard to think of a published author in living memory who risked arrest in the UK for their political beliefs, hard to think of one whose books could be published anywhere but here.

notizie.titolo: Cost of balancing Great Britain’s power grid reaches nearly £50m a day
notizie.riassunto: Grid operator paying large sums to switch off windfarms in areas of excess electricity generation while turning on gas plants elsewhere The cost of balancing Great Britain’s power grid has soared to near-record highs of almost £50m a day after windfarms were turned off because of bottlenecks in transmitting power around the country. The grid operator paid £47.
